World Cup 2026 Knockout Stage Matches and Fan Reactions

The FIFA World Cup 2026 is progressing into its knockout stages, with teams like France and Norway securing spots in the Round of 16. Norway's Erling Haaland scored a late winner against Ivory Coast, celebrating with themed social media posts. Portugal's coach stated they will approach the knockouts with intense focus. Meanwhile, fans experienced moments of both triumph and elimination. In one match, play was briefly interrupted by individuals entering the field.
